svg.title: Timeline of World History
svg.desc: 228 selected histories. Time flows from 4500 BCE at the top to 2026 CE at the bottom on one linear scale. Width shows an approximate editorial weighting of reach, influence and lasting impact. Regional lanes expand and contract, in the left-to-right order shown. It is not a measurement of territory, population or the worth of a people. Select a block for Wikipedia, dates and its sizing explanation.
svg.text: REGIONS RUN LEFT → RIGHT · LANES EXPAND WITH PROMINENCE
